senses.gloss: to live in, use, or take up a place or space

definition_translations.zh_TW: 居住、使用或占用某個地方或空間
definition_translations.ja_JP: 場所や空間に住む、使う、または占める
definition_translations.vi_VN: sống trong, sử dụng hoặc chiếm một nơi hay không gian
definition_translations.th_TH: อาศัย ใช้ หรือครอบครองสถานที่หรือพื้นที่

senses.gloss: to keep someone busy or engaged
senses.example: The training session will occupy most of the afternoon.

example_translations.zh_TW: 這場訓練課程會占用下午大部分時間。
example_translations.ja_JP: その研修は午後の大半を占める予定です。
example_translations.ko_KR: 그 교육 세션은 오후 대부분을 차지할 것입니다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Buổi đào tạo sẽ chiếm phần lớn buổi chiều.
example_translations.th_TH: การอบรมจะใช้เวลาส่วนใหญ่ของช่วงบ่าย

definition_translations.ja_JP: 人を忙しくさせる、または引きつける
definition_translations.vi_VN: giữ cho ai đó bận rộn hoặc tham gia
definition_translations.th_TH: ทำให้บางคนยุ่งหรือมีส่วนร่วม

senses.gloss: to take control of a place by force
senses.example: The army moved quickly to occupy the border town.

example_translations.zh_TW: 軍隊迅速行動，占領了邊境城鎮。
example_translations.ja_JP: 軍は国境の町を占領するため、迅速に行動しました。
example_translations.ko_KR: 군대는 국경 마을을 점령하기 위해 신속히 이동했습니다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Quân đội nhanh chóng tiến vào chiếm thị trấn biên giới.
example_translations.th_TH: กองทัพเคลื่อนกำลังอย่างรวดเร็วเพื่อยึดเมืองชายแดน

definition_translations.ja_JP: 武力で場所を支配する
definition_translations.vi_VN: kiểm soát một nơi bằng vũ lực
definition_translations.th_TH: เข้าควบคุมสถานที่ด้วยกำลัง
